Details and how to get the data
- BLS series for “All items less food and energy” (U.S. city average, CPI-U) is CPILFESL.
- To compute YoY core inflation for month M in year Y:
  YoY% = (Index_M_Y / Index_M_(Y-1) − 1) × 100
- You can get monthly index values from the BLS series CPILFESL at bls.gov (Producer: series ID CPILFESL).
